name: coolify-cloudflare-cache-purge
description: A Cloudflare Worker that purges an application's Cloudflare cache after a successful Coolify deployment.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run deploy:dry-run

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: A Cloudflare API token scoped to this zone with the Zone / Cache Purge permission.

CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID.description: The Cloudflare Zone ID containing the application hostname.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: A random secret of at least 32 characters. Add it to the Coolify webhook URL as the token query parameter.

PURGE_MODE.description: Use hostname (recommended) to purge only the deployed hostnames, or everything to purge the entire zone.

ALLOWED_APPLICATION_UUIDS.description: Optional comma-separated Coolify application UUID allowlist. Leave empty to accept any authenticated application.

PURGE_HOSTNAMES.description: Optional comma-separated hostname override. Leave empty to use the fqdn values sent by Coolify.
